name: wh
description: The Mechanicus skills for Herdr + Claude: conclave (parallel workers), servo-skull (one Claude beside you), reconsecrate (update from the repo), augment (the AUGMENTATIONS self-improvement notes become commits), petition (open the PR), scriptorium (a file opened in a JetBrains IDE's LightEdit, else VS Code) and expurgate (a servo-skull cleans the needless comments out of a PR).
